lines.text: Light snow at the trailhead. Kai didn't think twice.
But wet snow kept landing on his pack and melting.
By the top, his spare layer was damp and his snacks were soggy.
The fix was already on his pack.
A rain cover, tucked in its own pocket.
Thirty seconds, and the pack stayed dry for the rest of the hike.
Save this before your next snowy hike.
